Ballerup is a Danish municipality that is tracked within the national healthcare system for its clinical quality in treating patients with atrial fibrillation. It is featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The report evaluates clinical outcomes across all 98 Danish municipalities to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Ballerup's specific data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is utilized in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AC) treatment using data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. 

Because the available corpus data for Ballerup is limited to a single tabular entry detailing its Indicator 5 metrics, no further historical, relational, or claim-based details are available beyond its statistical inclusion in this specific clinical quality report [^src1].
